drugs.name: Escitalopram
drugs.mechanism: Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) increasing extracellular 5-HT synaptic concentration
drugs.efficacy: First-line antidepressant pharmacotherapy for major depressive episodes
drugs.adverse_effects: Nausea, insomnia, sexual dysfunction, somnolence, sweating

drugs.name: Sertraline
drugs.mechanism: Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) with minor dopamine transport inhibition
drugs.efficacy: High-efficacy, well-tolerated first-line agent across diverse depressive patient populations
drugs.adverse_effects: Diarrhea, nausea, tremor, insomnia, dry mouth

drugs.name: Duloxetine
drugs.mechanism: Serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (SNRI) modulating descending pain pathways and mood
drugs.efficacy: Dual efficacy for emotional symptoms and painful somatic symptoms of MDD
drugs.adverse_effects: Nausea, dry mouth, constipation, decreased appetite, hyperhidrosis

drugs.name: Bupropion
drugs.mechanism: Norepinephrine-dopamine reuptake inhibitor (NDRI) and nicotinic acetylcholine receptor antagonist
drugs.efficacy: Antidepressant with favorable sexual side-effect profile and weight neutrality
drugs.adverse_effects: Insomnia, dry mouth, headache, agitation, rare dose-dependent seizures

drugs.name: Esketamine
drugs.mechanism: S-enantiomer of ketamine non-competitively antagonizing NMDA receptors to stimulate BDNF/mTOR synaptic plasticity
drugs.efficacy: Rapid-acting efficacy within 24 hours in treatment-resistant depression
drugs.adverse_effects: Dissociation, dizziness, nausea, sedation, transient blood pressure elevation

drugs.name: Vortioxetine
drugs.mechanism: Multimodal antidepressant inhibiting 5-HT transporter and acting as 5-HT1A agonist / 5-HT3 antagonist
drugs.efficacy: Improves depressive symptoms and cognitive function deficits in MDD
